# FrostKeep

> Encrypted cold backups for Proxmox. An MIT-licensed Python CLI for backing up Proxmox VE QEMU virtual machines and LXC containers to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive using vzdump and rclone crypt.

Guest backups are independent full archives, without incremental backups or deduplication. Encrypted host configuration and recovery metadata use S3 Standard. Guest recovery requires AWS archive retrieval, followed by a size and SHA-256 verified download. Restored guests remain stopped. Keep local backups and independent recovery keys; validate backup and restore on each installation.

This is a public documentation index for tools that accept llms.txt context. Coding instructions live in AGENTS.md; this index does not grant permission to operate a host or cloud account.

- [Setup and recovery](https://github.com/EMOEMOJAI/FrostKeep/blob/main/docs/guide.md): Storage, keys, scheduling, alerts, interrupted runs and guest restoration.
- [Security](https://github.com/EMOEMOJAI/FrostKeep/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Trust boundaries and vulnerability reporting.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/EMOEMOJAI/FrostKeep/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Validation and public release export.
- [Coding agent guide](https://github.com/EMOEMOJAI/FrostKeep/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository map, checks and operational boundaries.
